answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain proportional voting weight. This creates a velvet barrier to entry where the cost of attacking scales linearly with total supply. Like shifting sand in a vast dune, identity costs fluctuate to punish rapid account generation. Even if an actor possesses jade-tier infrastructure, they cannot bypass the economic penalty imposed by burning capital, ensuring that resource scarcity anchors network legitimacy.
